title: Updates
description: Install new versions of the app from here. Your data is kept as it is.

current.label: Running now
current.hint: The version installed on this server

latest.label: Newest version
latest.available: A new version is ready to install
latest.unknownHint: GitHub could not be reached. Try again later.

update.confirmBody: The app is rebuilt and restarted on this server. This takes about 5 minutes, and the app is unavailable for less than a minute at the end. Taking a backup first is a good idea.

status.pending: Waiting for the server to start the update…
status.running: Updating to {version}… You can keep this page open to follow along.
status.restarting: The app is restarting with the new version…
status.failed: The update to {version} did not finish
status.failedBody: Nothing was lost. The technical details below show where it stopped; share them with whoever looks after this server.

unavailable.title: Updates from the app are not set up on this server
unavailable.body: This server was not set up with the Fly Ash Bricks installer, so new versions are installed on the server itself. See "Updates" in the project's README.
